variants.name: Chicken & Turkey 100 g
variants.about_this_item: GEMON HIGH PREMIUM QUALITY is a line of complete pet foods formulated with quality ingredients, selected to meet the nutritional needs of your animals. Highly palatable recipes, tailored to the different ages and lifestyles of the animal. No added artificial dyes and preservatives. Made in Italy and No Cruelty Test. GEMON CHUNKIES WITH CHICKEN AND TURKEY is a complete pet food for sterilised adult dogs of every sizes, formulated to provide all necessary nutrients for the daily vitality of our four-legged friends.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and animal derivatives 45% (fresh chicken 10% and fresh turkey 10%), derivatives of vegetable origin, minerals.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 9.5%, crude fibre 0.8%, crude fat 4.5%, crude ash 2.3%, moisture 82.0%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate) 2500 IU, Vitamin D3 140 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 5mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes for adult dogs (see table) may be split into 2 meals. Serve at room temperature. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 2 days. Do not open the package if it is damaged or swollen. Store in a cool and dry place. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. Dog food only, not suitable for human consumption.
